title: Rooftop Retreat & Skyline Views
description:
Elevate your Music City experience with breathtaking skyline views from a rooftop deck, featuring a grill and seating for 12. Minutes from Nissan Stadium, Broadway, and the trendy East Nashville dining scene, you'll be immersed in all the city's top attractions. Inside, enjoy endless fun with foosball, air hockey, ping-pong, 4K TVs, and a Sonos sound system. Perfect for family reunions, corporate stays, or bachelor/bachelorette parties. 

Make entertainment and relaxation memories of a lifetime!

Other things to note

One parking spot in the driveway in front of the garage. Plenty of street parking for other guests.
